scope: three distinct R1 design proposals; not canonical approval

prompts.prompt: Create ONE new robot family design proposal for CLO-01, based on the reference ONLY as shared white-gloss robot material/proportion/design-language reference. Do NOT copy Chloe's plates or just recolor her. Friendly advanced AI robot, sturdy cute 3.6-to-3.8-head full-body proportions, black-glass emissive face display, white clearcoat painted beveled armor with mild early-generation faceting, graphite joints, subtle CYAN blue light with restrained spill. DISTINCT PLATES CLO-01: broad squared double-layer shoulder pauldrons with an outer beveled trapezoid cap and a narrower inner overlapping plate; broad chest with one large hexagonal sternum and two upright side plates, simple vertical central groove; angular brow/helmet framing with a flatter forehead; compact shield-shaped knee plates without circular eye-like motifs; moderate boots not oversized. Face: friendly round-to-oval digital eyes, simple brows and tiny smile, distinct expression from Chloe, no human skin. Five articulated fingers each hand with four long fingers and separate thumb, white finger shells and graphite palms with anatomical thumb-base volume; no hand-back or palm LEDs. A few discreet hex-socket fasteners only. Forehead miniature black monitor reads 프리패스 in fine subtle luminous dot glyphs; chest mark CLO-01 with small R1 below, no other text or character names. Neutral front three-quarter full-body standing pose, arms relaxed, complete head and boots visible. Studio dimensional 3D + editorial cartoon appeal, clean soft neutral light. Genuine transparent alpha, single robot, no scenery, no weapon, no floor/shadow. This is a new R1 proposal, not a replacement for approved CLO-02.

Create ONE distinct CLO-03 R1 robot design proposal, using reference only as shared family white-clearcoat/graphite/display material and sturdy cute 3.6-3.8-head proportions. Not a Chloe recolor. Friendly advanced AI robot with glossy white painted beveled shell and restrained MINT-GREEN emissions, black glass digital expression screen, no skin. DISTINCT CLO-03 PLATES: THREE overlapping relatively slim angular pauldron tiers per shoulder, stepping diagonally backward like carefully fitted laminated armor, not broad chunky double caps. Chest formed from 3 interlocking chevron tiles with a narrow central pentagon and two diagonal lateral plates; double overlapping abdominal bands; hexagonal/angled ear outer housings instead of Chloe's round puck silhouette; helmet brow two shallow diagonal facets. Knees angular split small trapezoid shields, NO eye-like circles. Compact balanced footwear, not thin limbs, sturdy early-gen armor with a few discreet hex-socket fasteners. Face expression: slightly narrower oval green emitted eyes, simple straight curved eyebrows, tiny calm smile and two small cheek pixels; different from Chloe's lashes and CLO-01. Forehead black mini-monitor reads 프리패스 as fine subtly glowing dot glyphs. Chest exact identifier CLO-03 with small R1, no invented name. Five articulated fingers per hand, separate thumb and 4 long fingers of substantial natural robot thickness, sculpted graphite inner palm and white outer shells. No hand/palm LEDs. Full body neutral three-quarter stance facing slightly viewer left, arms relaxed, head and boots complete with generous margins. Dimensional polished 3D + editorial cartoon appeal, soft clean lighting, genuine transparent alpha, single robot only, no shadows/floor/scenery/weapons/text panels. New design candidate, not canonical CLO-02 replacement.

Create ONE new CLO-04 (Cl oa / 클로아) R1 robot proposal, using reference ONLY for shared white clearcoat robot material, cute sturdy 3.6-3.8-head proportions and digital-glass face language. Do NOT duplicate Chloe plates or simply recolor. White glossy beveled painted armor, graphite joints, restrained warm CORAL-ORANGE emissions. DISTINCT CLO-04 PLATES: offset two-piece swept trapezoid shoulder pauldron per side, broad smooth top cap sweeping outward and a smaller inset angular plate underneath, less squared than CLO-01 and NOT three-tier lamellae like CLO-03; torso uses a narrow tapered double-V breastplate and four small lateral rib plates, broad single continuous waist plate, compact faceted teardrop-like knee SHIELDS with flattened tips (not eye circles). Helmet has a subtle central raised angular crest and offset cheek plates, ear housings flattened oval with angular outer bevel. Friendly digital eyes slightly almond/round with short restrained lashes and calm curved smile, distinct from Chloe yet same family. A few tidy hex-socket fasteners, no screws everywhere. Forehead black mini monitor reads 프리패스 as fine subtly emitted dot lettering. Chest exact CLO-04 and small R1, no other text. Hands each with separate thumb and four long articulated white-shell fingers, sculpted graphite inner palms; no hand-back or palm LEDs. Moderate compact boots and substantial arms/legs. Full-body neutral three-quarter view facing slightly right, relaxed hands, entire head and footwear in generous margins. High-quality dimensional 3D + editorial cartoon rendering, smooth reflective clearcoat but modest early-gen faceting, soft light. Genuine transparent alpha cutout, no floor, shadow, backdrop, weapons, scenery or other people. This is a new proposed revision, not approval of a previously rejected orange robot.
